media:group.media:title: LIVE I Race 2 I Barcelona I McLaren Trophy Europe 2026
media:group.media:description:
Erik Behrens and Alejandro Geppert have become the runaway leaders in the Pro-Am class, but a double victory in Misano for Ferdinando D'auria and Dimitrios Papanastasiou helped them claw back points.
It’s a similar story in the Am class with Charlie Martin building a strong lead, but Misano race winner Cedric Leimer has his eyes on the top spot. It’s shaping up to be an intriguing battle to the end.
